bad_usb: Runs keyboard scripts (Bad USB, Ducky syntax) over USB.
example_adc: Developer example that reads analog voltages on the GPIO pins with the ADC.
example_advanced_plugins: Developer example of an app that loads plugins which call back into the app.
example_apps_assets: Developer example that reads data files shipped with the app in its assets folder.
example_apps_data: Developer example that stores user data in the app's own data folder.
example_ble_beacon: Developer example that broadcasts a custom Bluetooth LE beacon.
example_custom_font: Developer example that draws text with a custom font.
example_date_time_input: Developer example of the view for entering a date and a time.
example_event_loop_event_flags: Developer example of the event loop reacting to event flags, shown with key presses.
example_event_loop_multi: Developer example of one event loop handling several event sources.
example_event_loop_mutex: Developer example of the event loop waiting on a mutex.
example_event_loop_stream_buffer: Developer example of the event loop reading a stream buffer.
example_event_loop_timer: Developer example of timers driven by the event loop.
example_images: Developer example that draws the app's own icons and images.
example_number_input: Developer example of the keyboard for entering a whole number within bounds.
example_plugins: Developer example of an app that loads one plugin file.
example_plugins_multi: Developer example of an app that loads several plugin files.
example_thermo: Developer example that reads a DS18B20 1-Wire thermometer on the GPIO header.
example_view_dispatcher: Developer example of switching between views with the view dispatcher.
example_view_holder: Developer example of showing a single view with a view holder.
gpio: Controls the GPIO pins, the 5 V output and the USB-UART bridge.
ibutton: Reads, saves, writes and emulates iButton (1-Wire) keys.
infrared: Learns, saves and sends infrared remote signals, with universal remotes.
lfrfid: Reads, saves, writes and emulates 125 kHz RFID cards and tags.
nfc: Reads, saves, writes and emulates NFC cards and tags.
subghz: Reads, saves and sends Sub-GHz remote signals, and analyzes the frequency in use.
u2f: Works as a U2F security key over USB for two-factor sign-in.
